children: Stonecutter Pharmaceuticals (01093) said the Phase II clinical trial of its SYH2085 tablets for treating adult uncomplicated influenza has officially started at the first centre in mainland China.

The company said the product is converted in the body into the main active metabolite SYH2085A-01207, which selectively inhibits the nuclease activity of the PA subunit of the viral polymerase and thereby blocks influenza virus replication, according to ETNet.

title: Stonecutter Pharmaceuticals Starts Phase II Trial Of SYH2085 For Adult Uncomplicated Influenza
